sourceHtml:
Tool Yonkers Rises — Yonkers Rises is an animated 3D diorama of New York City in which a giant mech, cut from the Yonkers boundary, rises from the ground and walks through Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx while a stomp counter and mech height readout track its progress. The scene plays a stand-up sequence followed by a looping stomping tour, with buildings flattened under each footfall, and the status line changes as it moves across land or wades through water.

I realized I didn't know where Yonkers was, so I looked it up on Google Maps and then, to help embed its location and shape in my head (and to try out Claude Fable 5.2's 3D modeling and animation skills), I prompted Fable 5.2 Medium to:

Make a three js animation where yonkers stands up as a big mech (cool stand up motion) and átomos around manhattan and queens and Brooklyn, use openstreetmap mapping data

It correctly deduced that "átomos" was a mobile keyboard typo for "stomps":

translation.html:
工具 Yonkers Rises — Yonkers Rises 是一个以纽约市为场景的动态 3D 立体模型，其中一台按扬克斯市边界轮廓切割而成的巨型机甲从地面升起，穿行于曼哈顿、布鲁克林、皇后区和布朗克斯，跺脚计数器和机甲高度读数会跟踪显示其行进情况。场景先播放一段起身动画，随后循环播放跺脚巡游，每次落脚都会踩平脚下的建筑，状态栏文字则会随机甲在陆地上行走或涉水前进而变化。

我发现自己不知道扬克斯在哪里，于是在 Google Maps 上查了一下。接着，为了把它的位置和形状记在脑海里（也为了试试 Claude Fable 5.2 的 3D 建模和动画能力），我向 Fable 5.2 Medium 输入了提示词，让它：

Make a three js animation where yonkers stands up as a big mech (cool stand up motion) and átomos around manhattan and queens and Brooklyn, use openstreetmap mapping data

它正确推断出，“átomos”是在手机键盘上输入“stomps”时打错的词：
